description: Who can quote a material or a Design Studio project: live Trade Exchange listings (price vs PackIndex benchmark) plus matched converters from the verified supplier network, filtered by country. Use before post_rfq. A project_id needs the user's OPN account; a material code works for anyone.

material_id.description: PackIndex code, e.g. RSC_0201, FBB, KRLNR

query.description: Supplier name or keywords, e.g. 'Box Co', 'FSC', 'Ontario'

region.description: Supplier country or region, e.g. Canada, CA, Germany, North America

name: find_suppliers
title: Exchange: find suppliers
